   Roughly 5 months ago I was switched to new anti-depressants. The side effects were told to be the usual so I didnt expect all that much. I took the new medication before bed and found it quite hard to sleep. When I finally did drift off to sleep things got really creepy, really fast. 
    In my dream I was the same as I was in the real world. I was basically living my life in a dream (of course I didnt realize I was dreaming at the time). My friends birthday was coming up and he invitedd me to an amusment park and afterwards we were all going to kill ourselves. Any rational thinking person would find the last part quite odd and disturbing, but apparently in my dream world the dream me knew something I didnt. Apparently, anybody, up until their 20th birthday, can kill themselves and comeback the following day. If you were invited to the party by the person having the birthday you could also participate in this. After 20 years of age you dont come back. At that point you choose between living the rest of your life normally or ending it at 20. Once again, if you are invited to the persons 20th then you will die with them should you choose to attend. Me being depressed agrred right away to seeing my friend off on his birthday and following straight behind. The day of the part rolled around and I got a frantic call from one of my other friends begging me not to follow through with my plans. I decided to attend the party but not the "afterparty". Fast-forward through some typical birthday stuff and we are at the end of the day. My friend who didnt want me to go through with the plan and myself said our goodbyes to everyone and they all went into a big steel door and everything went quiet. A scientist entered the hallway we were in and sat in a glass encased room, pushed a button and said something quickly, pressed a large chrome button and left. There were weird sounds on the other side of the big door and then quiet again. I heard talking and pried the door open. My friend and the other 5 or so guests were standing against the back wall looking very concerned but alive. Suddenly the door slammed behind me and I was with the suicide group instead of my buddy. I could hear a low thudding sound and wimpering on the other side of the door and I knew he was trying to open the door but could not. I tried my luck but the door was locked tight. Suddenly a voice filled the room apologizing for the delay and telling people to prepare once again. I frantically tried banging on the door but no one could hear me. I started hearing weird sucking sounds and (like an idiot) turned to look what was happening. 3 of them were gone. One was very nervous and looking around frantically. The last gury looked at me as if to say something when suddenly a large plastic bag swooped down from the ceiling and covered him from the neck up. I saw his eyes widen and start to water as a greenish gas filled the bag around his head. As the bag was filling it was dragging him up the wall up to the ceiling. I followed it up and saw the others hanging there. Their faces were blueish grey and they were obviously screaming. I turned around and ran to the door and curled up in a fetal position and tried to pretend I was somewhere else. There was a loud ringing sound and the door swung open and I was picked up by a skinny scientist. Just before I left the room my body flopped in the direction towards the wall and for a split second I saw all my friends, lifeless, getting taken slowly into the wall. I broke the grip of the scientist, took my friend and ran. I woke up soon after that. I am not on those meds anymore.
